A disappearance in a secluded community. A mountain hiding its secrets. A detective running out of time. Only the foolish and the desperate attempt to wander the mazelike trails of Hillthorn. Even those who know their way may still stumble upon dangerous wildlife or a local villager’s piercing gaze. But a child has gone missing, time is in short supply, and you’re the one being tasked with unraveling the mountain’s secrets. Welcome to Hillthorn, a dark investigation game unlike any other, where the mystery unfolds without a single word spoken. A World in CardsEvery eerie and unsettling detail of Hillthorn's story is revealed entirely through Clue cards, which can be Investigated, Explored or in some instances Talked to in your search to get closer to truth behind the disappearance.You Are an OutsiderYou've been tasked to find a missing person, though it’ll take some finesse to draw information from the locals, who seem reluctant to share details with someone outside their flock.Time is in Short SupplyThe clock is ticking. There are too many threads to follow and too little time. Something seems keen on letting you revisit untrodden paths, but at what cost? Features• Discover a strange mountain and uncover its secrets.• Card-based investigation with no dialogue.• The clock ticks with every action.• Multiple endings to discover• Knowledge as progression.• No Generative AISoftware description provided by the publisher.Related tagsAdventurePuzzle-solving elementsShow moreAbout this itemGame file size (estimated)Nintendo Switch: 420 MBNintendo Switch 2: 420 MBSupported play modesTV modeTabletop modeHandheld modeSoftware compatibility and play experience may differ on Nintendo Switch Lite. source.title: Warhammer Survivors
source.evidenceText: Slide 1 of 7Fantasy Violence, Mild BloodGamesWarhammer SurvivorsReleases 11/10/26VersionNintendo Switch 2EditionDigitalSale ends: 11/18/26 at 07:59 a.m. UTCFantasy Violence, Mild BloodLoadingWarhammer Survivors is a fast-paced roguelite survivors' game, pitting a host of iconic Warhammer characters against endless hordes of enemies from multiple Warhammer factions. Developed by Auroch Digital (Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun) in partnership with Warhammer and poncle (Vampire Survivors), discover the universes of Warhammer 40,000 and Warhammer: Age of Sigmar in all its pixel glory in this new surviv-a-ton.FEATURES - Fast and frantic Survivors gameplay. - A roster of iconic characters from the Warhammer 40,000 and Warhammer: Age of Sigmar universes, featuring Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun’s very own Malum Caedo! - Multiple modes and stages from across the grim, dark 41st Millennium and the Mortal Realms. - An arsenal of familiar weapons, such as the Boltgun, Astartes Chainsword, Whirlwind Axes and easter eggs such as the humble pot of Nuln Oil. - A mighty cache of passives and power-ups to aid in enduring against the monstrous legions. - Esoteric secrets to uncover and collectables to collect! UNLEASH DESTRUCTION ACROSS TWO UNIVERSES Choose your universe and engage in frenetic battles across the open and ashen plains of Aqshy to the tight and confined corridors of an abandoned Space Hulk. Every stage is a new arena of slaughter, each with its unique enemy faction... and secrets to uncover.LEGENDARY CHAMPIONSSelect from a roster of renowned champions from both the Warhammer 40,000 and Warhammer Age of Sigmar universes. Play as the mighty Space Marine Sternguard Veteran, Malum Caedo, and the lightning-forged Stormcast, Neave Blacktalon, among a host of others. Each character comes with unique weapons and starting stats – no two survivors play the same.AN ARSENAL OF ICONIC WEAPONS Wield an arsenal of iconic weapons drawn from the armouries of the far future and the Mortal Realms. Eviscerate Tyranid hordes with a chainsword, or pulverise enemies with the unrelenting Bolter... and, if all that doesn’t work, drown them in a pot of Citadel Nuln Oil paint. Mix and match weapons with power-ups and evolve them into devastating new forms to create screen-clearing storms of bullets, blades and magic.ENDLESS HORDES Obliterate the skittering, beady-eyed Skaven and their horde of warp-addled abominations or stand your ground against the ravenous Tyranid swarm and its myriads of monstrous Xenos Bioforms. Bring your weapons to bear against the endless hordes of these factions (and more) from the Warhammer 40,000 and Warhammer Age of Sigmar universes!META PROGRESSION Death is not the end for these champions of endless war. A growing roster of unlockable characters, weapons, abilities and rare relics will increase your odds of survival.Software description provided by the publisher.Explore this game's official websiteRelated tagsActionPixel artRaise your statsStart over if you failSurvivalShow moreAbout this itemGame file size (estimated)Nintendo Switch: 600 MBNintendo Switch 2: 600 MBSupported play modesTV modeTabletop modeHandheld modeNo. of playersSingle system (1)Nintendo Account family-group lendingSupportedNintendo Switch OnlineSave Data CloudPlay online, access classic NES™ and Super NES™ games, and more with a Nintendo Switch Online membership.
